before: Be strong and courageous, for you will lead these people into possession of the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
after: Be strong and courageous, for you will give these people their inheritance—the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
rationale: Renders the causative inherit verb with inheritance explicitly, making the opening commission connect with the repeated inheritance language in the allotments. Joshua remains the agent who distributes the LORD’s promised gift; the oath and recipients remain.
tsw_comparator: Be strong and courageous, for you shall cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their ancestors to give them.

before: He summoned all Israel—its elders, heads, judges, and officials—and told them, “I am old, advanced in years.
after: He summoned all Israel—its elders, heads, judges, and officers—and told them, “I am old, advanced in years.
rationale: Uses officers for shoterim, matching 1:10, 3:2 and 8:33 so readers recognize the same community role at the farewell assembly; all four leadership categories remain.
tsw_comparator: Joshua called all Israel, their elders, heads, judges, and officers, and said to them, “I am old, advanced in days.

before: Joshua gathered all Israel’s tribes at Shechem. He summoned Israel’s elders, heads, judges, and officials, and they presented themselves before God.
after: Joshua gathered all Israel’s tribes at Shechem. He summoned Israel’s elders, heads, judges, and officers, and they presented themselves before God.
rationale: Keeps the same officers designation for shoterim as in the earlier assemblies and 23:2, preserving Shechem, the four leadership categories and presentation before God.
tsw_comparator: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem and summoned the elders of Israel, its heads, its judges, and its officers, and they presented themselves before God.
